The clef rule: a passage of 5 columns or more

Implementation 04-7. A hand changes to its other clef only for a whole passage, 5 of its columns or more. A shorter stretch stays in the hand's own clef: ledger lines, and an octave line for the notes too far for them (the left hand: 8va over the bass clef; the right hand: 8vb under the treble clef). A clef set by hand stays. Each case shows a passage drawn by the app with the old rule and with the new one; the yellow band marks the columns whose clef or octave line changed. Nothing else of the sheet changes.
